abort.unsupported_brand: This is a {brand} gateway. Its code and error tables are not written yet, so it cannot be set up. See the intesis-gw-modbus library for how to contribute them.
abort.unsupported_device: The device on this port did not identify itself as a supported Intesis gateway.

error.device_in_use: The serial port is already in use with other settings. Use the same baud rate as the other devices on this line.
error.gateway_starting: The gateway is still starting up and does not report its values yet. Wait a few minutes and try again.

data_description.has_vane: The gateway cannot tell whether the indoor unit has a motorised vane, so this is pre-filled from what it last reported. Turn it off for a unit without one and the climate entity will not offer swing modes.

features.description: Confirm what the indoor unit behind the gateway can do.

data_description.baudrate: The speed set on the gateway's SW3/SW4 DIP switches. The Intesis default is 9600.
data_description.unit_id: The gateway's Modbus slave address, set on its SW3 DIP switches. The Intesis default is 1.

user.description: Set up a gateway wired to a serial port over RS-485 (8 data bits, no parity, 2 stop bits). The gateway model is detected from its device ID.

no_component_answered.message: The gateway answered none of the register blocks.

write_failed.message: The gateway did not accept the command.

wrong_model.message: The gateway on this port reports another device ID than the model this entry was set up as. Remove the entry and set the gateway up again.
